title: Canonical Worker Parameter/Forcing Cache Reuse and Allocation-Churn Qualification

source_bound_problem.parameter_cache: configure_parameters deallocates and reallocates soil geometry, MvG cache and provider objects on every kernel advance, even when the next column has the same cache shapes
source_bound_problem.forcing_cache: prepare_interval deallocates and reallocates qdra/qssdi/qrot on every interval preparation, even when the next column has the same cache shapes
source_bound_problem.kernel_call_frequency: kernel_advance_interval calls model%configure_parameters once per requested kernel interval; run_canonical_interval calls model%prepare_interval once before transaction/substep execution
source_bound_problem.existing_worker_ownership: one backend/model/workspace per worker, so reuse can remain worker-local and introduces no per-column cache state

parameter_behavior: allocate soil parameter/provider cache objects only when absent
reuse z/dz/node_distance allocation when active_nodes shape is unchanged
reallocate those arrays only when shape changes
recompute and overwrite all MvG cached values for every configure_parameters call
do not skip data copy or constitutive preprocessing based only on parameter_set_id
forcing_behavior: reuse qdra/qssdi/qrot only when their exact extents match the new forcing
overwrite all values on every prepare_interval call
selected_candidate.memory_semantics: exact-shape reuse must not retain a larger previous capacity after a shape change; current-shape dynamic payload remains unchanged relative to F-PE08
selected_candidate.direct_immutable_views: DEFERRED: current solver-contract/lifetime ownership does not yet provide a sufficiently explicit direct registry-view lifetime contract for this optimization
selected_candidate.same_parameter_id_shortcut: PROHIBITED in F-PE09 because registry uniqueness/content identity is not independently qualified here

forbidden_changes: soil-water public solver contract ownership semantics

qualification_gates.source_scope: only the two allowed production files may change relative to F-PE08
cache_semantics: same-shape parameter refresh reuses allocation while fully overwriting/recomputing cache values
changed-shape parameter refresh reallocates to exact new shape
same-shape forcing refresh reuses allocation while fully overwriting values
changed-shape forcing refresh reallocates to exact new shape
scientific_regression: full F-MR20 restricted V1 scientific matrix retained
qualification_gates.PE08_regression: canonical A23BU scratch remains disabled on the explicit reference workspace and PE08 scientific equivalence remains intact
qualification_gates.performance: measure allocation-reuse behavior first; any runtime comparison is characterization only and cannot create a speedup guarantee

explicit_nonclaims: lower worker payload bytes than F-PE08
parallel physics expansion beyond F-MR20 V1

open: implement exact-shape MvG and backend cache reuse
run F-MR20 V1 scientific regression under O0/O2
persist results and close only if all gates pass
